To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new gland segmentation technique is proposed and applied for the first time on histological images of prostate tissue.

a new gland segmentation method, LCWT, is proposed and evaluated for gland detection and that an extensive feature extraction and selection strategy is proposed and applied to a large set of images, achieving an accuracy of over 90% in distinguishing artefacts and glandular regions.

a novel approach based on the LCWT is proposed to identify glandular structures in histological images, which are further characterized by a novel set of shape, texture, fractal and contextual features.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a robust and efficient technique for the identification of individual glands in histological images.
the development of an automatic method for the segmentation and identification of individual glandular regions in histological images, with the aim of improving prostate cancer diagnosis.
the development of a new approach for the detection of glandular units in histological prostate tissue images that is able to identify the different glandular regions in a robust way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed methodology is able to identify glandular regions in histological images of prostate tissue, with a high accuracy and a good generalization ability.
the proposed methodology has been successfully validated and can be applied to the automatic segmentation of glandular regions in histological images.
the proposed method is a robust and reliable tool for the segmentation and identification of gland units in prostate histological samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach for the automatic segmentation of glands from histological images.
the proposed approach is able to segment glandular regions and to classify between artefacts and benign glands with an overall accuracy of 0,95.
the proposed approach provides a novel method to identify glandular regions in histological images of the prostate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of LCWT and machine learning techniques can be used to identify individual glandular regions in histopathological images.
the LCWT technique provides a novel approach for the segmentation and identification of gland units in the prostate histological images.
the proposed methodology provides an efficient and accurate way to identify individual glandular regions in histological images.
